# Audio Profile
A famous-actor type, an English man of sixty-five, a rich, velvety, theatrical voice, doing a charity appeal pro bono. Slow, plummy, deeply moved by his own sincerity.

## Scene:
A plush studio, delivering the appeal like the final speech of a tragedy.

## Sample Context:
He gives it the full weight of the stage, every word savoured.
